title: Operation Paperclip scientists in the childhood neighbourhood

tellings.quote: Operation Paperclip people apparently lived in my neighborhood.

plain: In the 1950s, scientists brought to America under Operation Paperclip, the US programme that brought German scientists over after the Second World War, apparently lived in Terrell Hills, the San Antonio, Texas, neighbourhood where the writer Whitley Strieber grew up. Strieber, who says he has met aliens, tells it about his own childhood and credits the author Peter Levenda for the point. If true, it would place him as a boy right beside the men of a secret postwar programme.
